description: This class, ConfigurationImage, manages configuration data represented as byte arrays. It provides facilities for creating configuration images from size or byte array, extracting content from a larger byte sequence, and retrieving ranges of bytes. It also defines a constant header used for binary file identification.

classes.name: ConfigurationImage
classes.description: Represents a configuration image with associated binary content and utility methods for manipulation, extraction, and cloning.

methods.name: ConfigurationImage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration content array to a specified size.

methods.name: ConfigurationImage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration content with a provided byte array.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the configuration content in bytes.

methods.name: extractContent
methods.description: Extracts the core content bytes from a larger ROM byte array, removing the header.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the internal configuration content byte array.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the configuration image.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Retrieves a specified range of bytes from the content array.
